::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_requests/{preq}"}
#docs
`amount_minor` is the live total of the invoices still open. An invoice paid, voided or written off elsewhere drops out (`settled_elsewhere`).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `preq` | `string` | **yes** | The preq. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such payment request |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_requests/Preq" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
